exposure: CFTR modulators (IVA, LUM/IVA, TEZ/IVA) used before and during pregnancy and lactation
cohort: The study included 61 women with cystic fibrosis (CF) experiencing 64 pregnancies while using CFTR modulators before and during pregnancy and lactation.
finding: CFTR modulators were generally well tolerated in pregnancy and breastfeeding, with only 2 maternal complications deemed related to the therapy, and women stopping modulators often experienced clinical decline that improved upon restarting therapy.
country: Europe, United Kingdom (UK), United States of America (USA), Australia, Israel
